business.what: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd is a Maharatna PSU engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, repair, overhaul, and upgrade of aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, avionics, and related aerospace systems, primarily serving the Indian Defence Forces and the non-military aerospace market.
business.geography: The company operates through 20 divisions and 10 R&D centers located across seven Indian states, primarily serving the Indian Defence Forces.

annual_report.what: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd is a Maharatna PSU engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, repair, overhaul, and upgrade of aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, avionics, and related aerospace systems, primarily serving the Indian Defence Forces and the non-military aerospace market.
annual_report.geography: The company operates through 20 divisions and 10 R&D centers located across seven Indian states, primarily serving the Indian Defence Forces.

risks.risk: Dependency on foreign OEMs for critical materials and LRUs.

synthesis.one_liner: HAL offers zero debt and strong cash flow, but consistently misses management's revenue growth guidance despite expanding order books.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management targets 10–12% revenue growth for FY27 after previously guiding for 8–10% in FY26 and 13% in FY25.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: TTM revenue grew 8%, while actual FY26 growth reached 6.8% and FY25 reached 2.0%, both missing guidance.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims EBITDA margins are maintained around 30% to 31% through cost optimization.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Operating margin was 22.8% in the Sep 2026 quarter and 30% over the latest full year.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management attributes inventory increases to long manufacturing cycles of 18 to 36 months.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Cash conversion cycle lengthened to 788 days from 475 days, as inventory days expanded from 527 to 859.

synthesis.credibility: Management has a poor track record with 0 delivered and 3 missed items out of 21 total. It consistently over-promises annual revenue growth, missing full-year targets in FY25 (2.0% vs 13%) and FY26 (6.8% vs 8–10%).

bull.point: Strong cash conversion and zero leverage provide significant balance sheet strength.
bull.evidence: Operating cash conversion was 125% over 5 years and debt-to-equity stands at 0.00x.

bull.point: Operating leverage is driving faster profit growth than revenue growth.
bull.evidence: PAT compounded at 16% over 3 years compared to 7% revenue compounding.

bear.point: Severe working capital lockup is stretching cash cycles significantly.
bear.evidence: Cash conversion cycle lengthened to 788 days, with inventory days expanding to 859 days.

bear.point: Earnings quality leans heavily on non-operating income.
bear.evidence: Other income accounts for 32% of pre-tax profit over the last twelve months.

bear.point: Track record of missing full-year revenue growth guidance.
bear.evidence: FY26 revenue growth came in at 6.8% against 8–10% guided.

watch: Execution of 20 LCA and 20 HTT-40 aircraft deliveries targeted for FY27.
FY27 revenue growth sustaining within the guided 10% to 12% range.
